rows.title: SPEC-01: Environment materialization — variables, secrets, runtimes, network, git and provider environments

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - One manifest with `kit`, `variables`, `secrets`, `network` and `git` compiles for all six profiles. It yields per-lane projections plus a list of owner prerequisites for the lanes that need them, without contacting a provider.
- **Local lanes:**
- A missing required secret fails preflight.
- The child env contains exactly the allowlist.
- A pre-push to a non-`mc/` ref is rejected.
- A receipt with `prepared` is produced.
- **cursor_cloud with `sync`:**
- A drill creates `mc-<kit>-<digest>` and syncs secret names.
- The launched agent produces a `prepared` receipt signal.
- A second mission with the same kit reuses the environment without an update.
- **No secret value** appears in any committed file, frame, log or binding. A test injects a sentinel secret and greps all outputs.

rows.capability: EnvironmentKit, variables/config refs, secrets, setup receipt, network/git/provider environment
rows.representative_workflow: SDLC config-resolution change review with real repo/toolchain; knowledge cited report with runtime artifact input
rows.observable_proof: Compile exact kit/vars/secretnames/network/git; missing secret refused; child allowlist; prepared receipt; Cursor sync then unchanged reuse; no secrets in outputs
rows.current_frontier_and_limits: Known implementation gap: config:<key> installation source absent; frozen for next session. Existing local/Cloud projection implementation otherwise needs exact configured/native proof.
rows.original_next_not_authority: Use the existing selected kit and exact current prerequisite/binding snapshot; establish Cursor repository access and authentication, then record prepared signals, a second unchanged mission and governed branch/PR custody. Join local environment proof to S0 rather than infer it from pure compilation.

rows.title: SPEC-02: Cognition materialization — skills, subagents, hooks, instructions, MCP and plugins per provider

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - One manifest selecting a skill, a subagent, a catalog hook, an MCP server and a plugin renders golden fixtures for all six profiles, with a degradation report per lane. Fixtures are re-recorded from the fact sheets.
- **Local, against a fixture repo with its own `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/skills/x` and `.cursor/hooks.json`:**
- Launch succeeds on all three local lanes.
- The repo files are byte-identical afterwards.
- The mission overlay is present.
- Discovery reports both the repo and the mission items.
- **Codex:**
- The kernel `before_tool` hook denies a forbidden command end-to-end on a live CLI drill, with trust handled.
- The release statement is updated to match the result.
- **cursor_cloud drill:**
- Inline `mcpServers` reach the agent.
- `.cursor/rules/mc-mission.mdc` is honoured.
- A `materialization.observed` signal arrives (needs SPEC-04 ingress).

rows.capability: Cognition profile expansion, skills/subagents/hooks/MCP, additive instructions, ambient inventory
rows.representative_workflow: Same SDLC workflow selects real cognition/sdlc; knowledge workflow selects cognition/knowledge plus actual Knowledge Services MCP
rows.observable_proof: Exact bundle custody/digests; unchanged repo AGENTS/skills/hooks; delivered then mechanism-reported discovery then exercised skill/hook; Codex trusted deny; Cursor inline MCP+observed signal
rows.current_frontier_and_limits: Cognition seed exists; no full selected live capability bindings/custody join. Provider-specific unsupported behavior must refuse.
rows.original_next_not_authority: Run the existing minimal local probes with one sealed skill/hook and preserved repo instructions, retain native discovery and deny evidence, then qualify Cursor observed signals through the existing ingress once prerequisites pass. No broad new cognition feature is implied.

rows.title: SPEC-03: Workspaces, worktrees and parallel placement for SDLC and knowledge missions

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - The three local lanes run with `policy.reuse: within_run`, a dirty-input refusal and cleanup after registration. The worktrees are removed and the snapshots are retained.
- **Fan-out of 5 cursor_cloud members** against one repo:
- produces 5 `mc/{run}/m{i}` branches, 5 agents and 5 head-SHA artifacts;
- throttles correctly when `max_active_agents: 3`.
- **A knowledge mission with no code repo:**
- launches on cursor_cloud against the knowledge workspace repo;
- fetches an Artifact input at run time;
- uploads an output Artifact that satisfies its Completion Contract.
- A forked cloud→local attempt reproduces the cloud head SHA in a local lease.

rows.capability: Workspaces, dirty input, snapshots, isolation/fanout and custody-before-cleanup
rows.representative_workflow: SDLC managed worktree with test evidence; knowledge artifact input/output; five cloud units throttled three
rows.observable_proof: Exact lease/base/inode before effects, distinct branches/heads, dirty refusal; registered snapshot/output before cleanup; five cloud members limit3
rows.current_frontier_and_limits: Earlier v2 partial cleanup is not typed proof; missing retired inode cannot be invented. MO-53 cross-lane fork deferred.
rows.original_next_not_authority: Join allocator/custody/cleanup to the exact S0 cells and the Cursor fan-out/knowledge drill, with immutable head/output evidence and declared concurrency. Retain failed work until custody instead of forcing cleanup.

rows.title: SPEC-04: Watchers, signals and callbacks — formal observation from provider environments to the orchestrating agent

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - **Ingress:**
- Run-token, Cursor-OIDC, provider-HMAC and environment-key signals are each accepted at their tier and rejected when wrong.
- Duplicates are dropped.
- Payload limits are enforced.
- Frames are persisted and visible in the transcript.
- **cursor_cloud drill:**
- The Telemetry Hook Pack delivers `session.started`, `materialization.observed` and `stop` signals through the tunnel.
- A gate hook enforces a `stop` within one tool call.
- **Watchers:**
- `ci-red-fix`, `stalled` and `artifact-to-ingest` fire deterministically in a Temporal test environment.
- They respect `max_fires`, rate, recursion and budget.
- A replay produces no duplicate actions.
- **Wake:** a Claude Code coordinator using recipe 1 is woken by a real `run.completed` without polling in its own context. Recorded as a qualification transcript.
- **No dead fields:** `controls.notifications` is consumed, and `channel: mcp` either works or is rejected by validation.

rows.capability: Native observation, typed signals/watchers/wake and one-tool stop
rows.representative_workflow: SDLC completion/review wake and inject; knowledge artifact.ready to accepted ingestion chain
rows.observable_proof: Signal tier/dedupe/transcript; deterministic limit/replay; actual idle caller wake/ack/resume; stop within one tool, not just HTTP202
rows.current_frontier_and_limits: Original watcher/wake issue boundaries done; wider selected native/remote cells not qualified.
rows.original_next_not_authority: Use the existing real caller wait/ack path in S0 and the scoped Cursor signal/gate drill in S1. Preserve dedupe, trust tiers, stop ordering and source-bound frames; provider webhooks only wake reconciliation.

rows.title: SPEC-05: Owner prerequisites and pre-spawn preflight — what only the owner can do, surfaced before a mission spawns

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - Preflight of a manifest that targets claude_cloud on a fresh installation lists A1–A7 and M1–M4 with generated paste blocks, and exits non-zero.
- After the steps and attestations, the probe mission runs and the prerequisites flip to `verified`.
- An expired A6 turns the lane back to blocked before the next launch.
- A launch through the API with unmet prerequisites returns `PREREQUISITES_UNMET` with the same list. The coordinator skill relays it verbatim.

rows.capability: Exact owner prerequisites, freshness, setup/preflight and typed launch refusal
rows.representative_workflow: Preflight same complete SDLC/knowledge manifest selected for launch, not generic account checklist
rows.observable_proof: Same PREREQUISITES_UNMET before create at API/CLI/MCP; generated kit/policy-bound steps; verified/stale/expired behavior
rows.current_frontier_and_limits: Human auth facts have dated surface scope; no repeat login when already done; do not elevate attestation to verified native readiness.

Current Cursor login/SCM access and exact native quota/budget evidence remain separate gates.

rows.title: SPEC-06: API-billed hosted lanes — Anthropic Managed Agents, OpenAI Agents API (Codex harness) and Sandbox Host placement

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: The cloud placements are drilled in HL-24 (`claude_managed`) and HL-25 (`codex_agents`), launched remotely through the AWS worker (SPRINT S2, S3). The self-hosted and Sandbox Host drills are HL-20, funding-gated (R31). Prepare starts from pack files (R30, HL-07, HL-11) and moves to the full projection in HL-21.
- Both new profiles pass the lane conformance suite against fakes, and describe honestly per §9.
- **`claude_managed` cloud drill:**
- A knowledge mission uploads skills, runs `mc_prepare`, emits signals, produces an output file, and settles usage and cost from `list_cost`.
- The budget-gate pause and resume works.
- An interrupt-and-inject works.
- **`claude_managed` self-hosted drill:**
- A code mission on a Docker SandboxHost runs in a worktree lease.
- The kernel deny works through the tool wrapper.
- `mc_publish` pushes a verified bundle and the PR is created through the effect.
- **`codex_agents` drills:**
- Hosted: a knowledge mission with artifacts.
- Self-hosted: a code mission with exec-server in Docker.
- Cancel, steer and the function-tool approval round trip.
- Recovery after killing the worker mid-stream reconciles from items with no duplicate frames.
- **`claude_agent_sdk` @sandbox drill:** the Claude Code CLI in Docker through the Model Gateway; hooks fire in-process; resume on a different worker through `SessionStore`.
- **Policy refusals:**
- A PHI-classed mission is refused on all API lanes.
- No org API key is present in any sandbox env or file (sentinel test).

rows.title: SPEC-08: Local CLI job skills — teaching any agent to drive Claude Code, Codex and Cursor CLIs headlessly, outside Mission Control

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - **Offline:**
- Unit tests for the job schema validation, adapter argv construction for every profile and OS, the env allowlist and redaction, and the result schema.
- A fake-CLI harness: scripted executables emitting recorded JSONL drive the loop through done, blocked, budget and timeout.
- **Live smoke (owner-authorized, cheap prompts, subscription accounts), to answer the open items:**
- Cursor: does `-p` write without `--force`? Does it read the prompt from stdin?
- Codex: exit codes and sandbox on Windows vs WSL.
- Claude: `result.subtype` on max-turns and schema failure.
- Which usage pool `claude -p` draws from after 2026-10-07.
- **End-to-end:** a Claude Code session launches two parallel jobs (a Codex fix and a Cursor review) in the background, is woken on completion, and reads both results.

rows.title: SPEC-09: Local harness path (slice S0) — Claude Code, Codex and Cursor harnesses through Mission Control on a WSL2 worker with local or Cloud Temporal

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - **Readiness is green on the WSL worker for all three lanes:**
- the CLIs found at pinned versions, not Windows shims;
- auth per route;
- lease roots on the Linux filesystem.
- **Each lane completes a probe mission launched from each tool** (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) on Windows, which is nine runs. In each run:
- the caller is woken by `missionctl wait`;
- one inject is delivered and recorded;
- one run is cancelled cleanly;
- the worktrees are cleaned after custody.
- **The same three-lane probe set passes on Temporal Cloud.**
- **No secret appears in frames or logs; the child envs contain only the allowlist.**

- Cursor cloud hooks deliver ordered signals through the deployed ingress.
- The gate's measured p99 is recorded.
- A stop takes effect within one tool call.
- An artifact over 4.5 MB arrives through the signed upload and is verified into custody.

rows.title: SPEC-11: Remote operation (slice R): thin Temporal worker on AWS ECS Fargate and the remote launch path

acceptance_clauses_verbatim.text: - The service runs one task with no inbound rules, and readiness passes against Temporal Cloud, Supabase (pooler) and S3.
- **Laptop-off proof:** with the owner's machine powered off, a hosted-lane probe mission runs to completion on the AWS worker, and its frames and payloads land in Postgres and S3.
- **Restart proof:** stopping and restarting the service mid-session reattaches with no duplicate frames.
- **Secret sentinel:** no secret value in the image, task definition, logs, repo or handoff.
- `deploy.ps1` redeploys a new build with no console steps.
- The 24-hour CPU and memory profile and the cost estimate are recorded in the handoff.
